title: Netra Binary Audio Frame Header (server to client only)
$comment: Approved 2026-09-12. Applies ONLY to server-to-client synthesized/playback audio frames sent as WebSocket binary messages. Microphone (client-to-server) audio upload is governed by its own approved protocol and MUST NOT be silently reinterpreted as this format. Wire layout of one binary WebSocket message: [4-byte unsigned big-endian header length][UTF-8 JSON header, matching this schema][raw audio bytes]. The header length field itself is not part of this JSON schema (it precedes the JSON); receivers must validate it against actual available frame bytes BEFORE attempting to parse the header. No base64 fallback exists or may be introduced — CLAUDE.md: audio is not transported as base64 JSON.

version.$comment: Unsupported/unknown versions must be rejected, not guessed at.

sequence.$comment: Per-generation frame ordering key. Must be strictly increasing within one generation_id: duplicate or decreasing sequence numbers are rejected. Gaps are permitted — transport/recovery must not assume every frame arrives.

media_type.$comment: Identifies the raw-byte encoding that follows the header; this schema does not enumerate a fixed provider-format list. INT-11b (20 September 2026): server speech is ElevenLabs with NETRA_ELEVENLABS_OUTPUT_FORMAT mp3_44100_128, sent as audio/mpeg; the server refuses to start with a non-mp3 format. The desktop plays audio/mpeg and audio/wav and keeps text only for anything else.

$commentMaxHeaderBytes: Custom keywords, not enforced by JSON Schema itself. Implementations MUST reject a declared header length over 16 KiB before attempting to parse. INT-11c (20 September 2026): one frame carries at most 64 KiB of audio, so a whole binary message is at most 4 + 16,384 + 65,536 = 81,924 bytes. The sender splits longer audio across frames and never truncates. A receiver that gets a larger or otherwise malformed frame rejects it, discards the rest of that segment's audio (keeping its text, which was delivered first) and keeps the connection open.
